We will sort it at no extra cost. Are lab grown diamonds real diamonds? + They are diamonds. Lab grown diamonds are chemically, physically, and optically identical to mined diamonds. A gemologist cannot tell the difference without specialized equipment. The FTC confirmed their equivalence in 2018.
L158: IGI grades them on the same cut, color, clarity, and carat scale as mined stones. The only difference is origin. What does the rhodium finish mean for maintenance? + Rhodium is a surface coating applied to white gold to enhance brightness and scratch resistance. It is standard on white gold jewelry and does not affect the solid gold setting underneath. Over years of daily wear the coating can thin. A jeweler can re plate it for a small fee. This is routine maintenance, not a flaw.
L159: Which metal should I choose? + Silver gives you the same bright white look as white gold at the lowest price point, a strong choice if you want the diamond to do the talking. 10K is the most durable for daily wear and where most customers land. 14K and 18K offer higher purity with a richer tone. Platinum is for people who buy once and never think about it again, dense, hypoallergenic, and never needs re plating. All options come in white, yellow, and rose gold.

Message us if you need push backs, French wires, or clip ons and we will build them to order. Are lab grown diamonds real diamonds? + Yes. Lab grown diamonds are chemically, physically, and optically identical to mined diamonds. A gemologist cannot tell the difference without specialized equipment. The FTC confirmed their equivalence in 2018.
L146: IGI grades them on the same cut, color, clarity, and carat scale as mined stones. The only difference is origin. What does the rhodium finish mean for maintenance? + Rhodium is a surface coating applied to white gold to enhance brightness and scratch resistance. It is standard on white gold jewelry and does not affect the solid gold setting underneath. Over years of daily wear the coating can thin. A jeweler can re plate it for a small fee. This is routine maintenance, not a flaw.

Are lab grown diamonds real diamonds? + They are diamonds. Lab grown diamonds are chemically, physically, and optically identical to mined diamonds. L157: IGI grades them on the same cut, color, clarity, and carat scale as mined stones. The only difference is origin. What does the rhodium finish mean for maintenance? + Rhodium is a surface coating applied to white gold to enhance brightness and scratch resistance. L141: How to Wear It +
L142: Worn on its own the diamonds do the work. Stacked with a plain chain bracelet on the same wrist it reads layered, not cluttered. Keep the other wrist quieter.

L150: Questions What wrist size does this fit? + Standard length is 7 inches, which fits most adult wrists. Need something different? Select your size at checkout or message us before ordering. We will sort it at no extra cost. Are lab grown diamonds real diamonds? + Yes. Lab grown diamonds are chemically, physically, and optically identical to mined diamonds. A gemologist cannot tell the difference without specialized equipment. The FTC confirmed their equivalence in 2018.
L151: IGI grades them on the same cut, color, clarity, and carat scale as mined stones. The only difference is origin. What does the rhodium finish mean for maintenance? + Rhodium is a surface coating applied to white gold to enhance brightness and scratch resistance. It is standard on white gold jewelry and does not affect the solid gold setting underneath. Over years of daily wear the coating can thin. A jeweler can re plate it for a small fee. This is routine maintenance, not a flaw.
L152: Which metal should I choose? + Silver gives you the same bright white look as white gold at the lowest price point, a strong choice if you want the diamond to do the talking. 10K is the most durable for daily wear and where most customers land. 14K and 18K offer higher purity with a richer tone. Platinum is for people who buy once and never think about it again, dense, hypoallergenic, and never needs re plating. All options come in white, yellow, and rose gold.

A 4 carat oval measures roughly 12 by 8 millimetres and its length spans about two thirds of the width of an average ring finger. What does VS1 clarity mean? + Very Slightly Included, first tier. L138: Sizing & Styling +

L140: 1 carat oval is approximately 7mm long by 5mm wide on the face up, slightly longer than a same carat round. The length is the point. The stone reads larger than its weight because the eye traces the long axis. One size fits all ear sizes.
L141:

L149: Questions Why are oval studs considered more flattering? + Oval diamonds elongate the visible silhouette. On the earlobe, this lengthens the lobe and draws the eye downward along the neck. Jewelers and stylists recommend oval cuts for the same reason they recommend V necklines and pointed toe shoes: the vertical line creates the illusion of length, which the eye reads as elegant. The effect is subtle but consistent.
L150: Will the diamonds catch on hair or clothing? + The four prong setting holds each oval flush to the lobe with no protruding stone height. The guardian backs lock flat against the back of the ear, no sharp posts. Hair, scarves, sweaters, and pillows do not catch. These are designed for daily wear, including sleep if you choose. Are lab grown diamonds real diamonds? + Yes. Lab grown diamonds are chemically, physically, and optically identical to mined diamonds.
L151: A gemologist cannot tell the difference without specialized equipment. The FTC confirmed their equivalence in 2018. IGI grades them on the same cut, color, clarity, and carat scale as mined stones. The only difference is origin. What are guardian backs? + Guardian backs are a secure earring closure with a flat backing disc that prevents the earring from sliding forward off the post. Combined with the screw or threaded post, they hold heavy stud earrings in place far better than standard friction backs.
L152: Standard on every Draco stud over 1 carat per ear. Which metal should I choose? + Yellow gold is the original Blue Nile choice and reads warm against most skin tones. White gold and platinum let the diamonds do the work, the cleanest, most modern look. Rose gold sits romantic and pairs well with warmer skin tones. Platinum is the most hypoallergenic option, ideal for sensitive ears. Silver delivers the white gold effect at the lowest price point. All gold options are solid 10K, 14K, or 18K, never plated.

L150: Questions What does inside out mean? + Diamonds are prong set on both the inside and outside surface of the hoop, not just the front facing surface. Standard hoops sparkle when the wearer faces directly at someone. Inside out hoops sparkle from every angle, including profile, hair down, and from behind. The technical term is eternity-style hoop, and it nearly doubles the visible diamond surface from any viewing angle. Are these comfortable for daily wear? + Yes.
L151: The 0.5 inch diameter is the most popular size for daily wear, small enough to fit under a phone, scarf, or pillow without catching. Are lab grown diamonds real diamonds? + Yes. Lab grown diamonds are chemically, physically, and optically identical to mined diamonds.
L152: A gemologist cannot tell the difference without specialized equipment. The FTC confirmed their equivalence in 2018. The lifetime warranty covers any stone loss from manufacturing defect at no cost.
L153: Accidental loss from impact is covered under our care plan, ask at checkout. We recommend a prong check once a year, which any jeweler can do in minutes. Which metal should I choose? + White gold and platinum let the diamonds do the work, the cleanest, most modern look. Yellow gold warms the stones and reads more vintage. Rose gold sits romantic. Lab grown diamonds are chemically, physically, and optically identical to mined diamonds.
L150: A gemologist cannot tell the difference without specialized equipment. The FTC confirmed their equivalence in 2018. IGI grades them on the same cut, color, clarity, and carat scale as mined stones. The only difference is origin. What does the rhodium finish mean for maintenance? + Rhodium is a surface coating applied to white gold to enhance brightness and scratch resistance. L151: Over years of daily wear the coating can thin. A jeweler can re plate it for a small fee. This is routine maintenance, not a flaw. Lab grown diamonds are chemically, physically, and optically identical to mined diamonds.
L146: A gemologist cannot tell the difference without specialized equipment. The FTC confirmed their equivalence in 2018. How do I know my size? + Email info@dracodiamond.com before ordering. A ring sizer ships to you free of charge anywhere in Canada or the United States. Are lab grown diamonds real diamonds? + Yes. Lab grown diamonds are chemically, physically, and optically identical to mined diamonds.
L151: A gemologist cannot tell the difference without specialized equipment. The FTC confirmed their equivalence in 2018. IGI grades them on the same cut, color, clarity, and carat scale as mined stones. The only difference is origin. What does the rhodium finish mean for maintenance? + Rhodium is a surface coating applied to white gold to enhance brightness and scratch resistance. It is standard on white gold jewelry and does not affect the solid gold setting underneath.
L152: Over years of daily wear the coating can thin. A jeweler can re plate it for a small fee. This is routine maintenance, not a flaw. Which metal should I choose? + Silver gives you the same bright white look as white gold at the lowest price point, a strong choice if you want the diamond to do the talking. 10K is the most durable for daily wear and where most customers land. 14K and 18K offer higher purity with a richer tone.

How do I know my size? + Email info@dracodiamond.com before ordering. A ring sizer ships to you free of charge anywhere in Canada or the United States. Are lab grown diamonds real diamonds? + Yes. Lab grown diamonds are chemically, physically, and optically identical to mined diamonds.
L152: A gemologist cannot tell the difference without specialized equipment. The FTC confirmed their equivalence in 2018. IGI grades them on the same cut, color, clarity, and carat scale as mined stones. The only difference is origin. What does the rhodium finish mean for maintenance? + Rhodium is a surface coating applied to white gold to enhance brightness and scratch resistance. It is standard on white gold jewelry and does not affect the solid gold setting underneath.
L153: Over years of daily wear the coating can thin. A jeweler can re plate it for a small fee. This is routine maintenance, not a flaw. L150: White metals hold the yellow at the most contrast. Yellow gold warms the setting and softens the difference between the centre and the white accents. Platinum is the heaviest and the most hypoallergenic.

L156: Questions Is the yellow colour natural to the diamond? + Yes. The colour comes from the diamond itself, not from a coating or a treatment applied afterwards. Lab grown yellow diamonds get their colour the same way mined yellow diamonds do, from nitrogen present as the crystal forms. What is a hidden halo? + A ring of small white diamonds set around the basket underneath the centre stone, facing outward rather than up. You do not see it looking straight down at the ring.
L157: You see it from the side, and it lifts the centre stone without widening it. Why are the side stones white rather than yellow throughout? + Two of the four side stones on each shoulder are yellow marquise and the rounds between them are colourless. Colourless stones next to a yellow centre make the yellow read deeper. An all yellow band flattens the effect. How big is a 3 carat cushion? + About 8.5mm across. On a size 6 it covers roughly half the width of the finger.
L158: Are lab grown diamonds real diamonds? + They are diamonds. Lab grown diamonds are chemically, physically, and optically identical to mined diamonds. A gemologist cannot tell the difference without specialized equipment. The FTC confirmed their equivalence in 2018. Can the ring be resized? + Yes. One complimentary resize is included within 60 days of delivery. After that a small jeweler fee applies. Message info@dracodiamond.com to arrange.
L159: Which metal should I choose? + White metals hold the yellow centre at the most contrast, which is why the piece is built in white gold. Yellow gold warms the whole setting and softens the difference between centre and accents. Platinum is dense, hypoallergenic and never needs re plating. All options come in solid 10K, 14K and 18K. L147: White gold sits cool against the stones and amplifies the sparkle. Yellow gold brings warmth. Rose gold sits between the two. Platinum is the heaviest and the most hypoallergenic. All options come in solid 10K, 14K, 18K.

L153: Questions Why bezel set instead of prongs? + A bezel wraps a thin collar of metal around the whole stone instead of gripping it with four claws. Nothing sits proud of the surface, so it does not catch on knitwear, hair or cuffs, and there are no prongs to wear down or bend. It is the setting jewellers recommend for a piece you intend to wear daily rather than occasionally. Will 7 inches fit me? + Seven inches is the standard womens length and fits most wrists with a little movement.
L154: Measure your wrist with a tape and add half an inch for a comfortable drape. If you need a different length, email info@dracodiamond.com before ordering and we will quote it. How does princess cut differ from round? + A princess cut is square with sharp corners and cuts deeper, so it holds more weight for its face up size and throws a brighter, more angular flash. In a bezel set line the square shape also sits edge to edge with almost no metal showing between stones, which is why the run looks continuous.
L155: Are lab grown diamonds real diamonds? + Yes. Lab grown diamonds are chemically, physically, and optically identical to mined diamonds. A gemologist cannot tell the difference without specialized equipment. The FTC confirmed their equivalence in 2018. IGI grades them on the same cut, color, clarity, and carat scale as mined stones. The only difference is origin. How do I clean it? + Warm water, a drop of dish soap and a soft toothbrush along the underside of the stones, then rinse and pat dry.
L156: Bezel settings trap less debris than prongs, so this is quick. Take it off before the gym, the pool and any harsh chemicals. Which metal should I choose? + Silver gives the same bright white look at the lowest price. 10K is the most durable for daily wear and where most customers land. 14K and 18K offer higher purity with a richer tone. Platinum is dense, hypoallergenic, and never needs re plating. All options come in white, yellow, and rose gold.

L153: Care is simple. Warm water and a soft brush. Step cuts show smudges sooner than brilliants, so a quick wipe keeps the mirrors clean.

L157: Questions What is a tapered baguette? + A long rectangular step cut that narrows at one end. Set on the shoulders with the narrow end outward, the pair draws a line down the finger and makes the emerald cut center read longer. It is the classic Art Deco side stone. Are lab grown diamonds real diamonds? + They are diamonds. Lab grown diamonds are chemically, physically, and optically identical to mined diamonds. A gemologist cannot tell the difference without specialized equipment.
L158: The FTC confirmed their equivalence in 2018. IGI grades them on the same cut, color, clarity, and carat scale as mined stones. The only difference is origin. Which metal should I choose? + Silver gives you the same bright white look as white gold at the lowest price point. 10K is the most durable for daily wear and where most customers land. 14K and 18K offer higher purity with a richer tone.
